answer: Proof of Stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by requiring capital commitment to validate network transitions. Like a river eroding barriers, stake weight forces an attacker to accumulate significant assets, rendering the cost of identity replication prohibitively expensive. An adversary attempting to subvert consensus must acquire a ferrous grip on circulating supply, an endeavor as arduous as planting a juniper forest in barren tundra to dilute the influence of honest nodes.
